entries.summary: Wrote and self-published six bilingual mathematics titles as First Editions (2026) under the CHNAI LAB imprint: matched Grade 6 and Grade 7 sets of an English–Khmer dictionary, an exercise book, and a full worked-solutions answer book — about 1,780 pages in total, written for Cambodian students who study mathematics in English.

contributions.text: Grade 6 set: an *English–Khmer Mathematics Dictionary* (240 pages), a *Mathematics Exercise Book* (595 original questions in six levels across twenty chapters, 260 pages), and a *Mathematics Answer Book* with a full worked method for every question (340 pages).

Grade 7 set: an *English–Khmer Mathematics Dictionary* (488 pages), a *Mathematics Exercise Book* (572 questions in six levels, chapter by chapter, written against the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport Grade 7 textbook, 156 pages), and a *Mathematics Answer Book* reprinting every question above its full worked solution (296 pages). All six books are free to download from the GitHub release linked below; five of the covers are shown in the photograph.
